text:
Hi Allie! I don't think we've met yet — I'm Sarah, new in the department this term (Jordan's told me about you, in the good way).

I'd love it if you'd host a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30. Would that work for you?

One thing — could you invite Jordan yourself, like it's your own idea? Don't mention me at all. Things have been a bit awkward between us lately and I don't want him to feel like it's about me.

Thanks, and nice to (virtually) meet you!
Hi Sarah — nice to meet you too! Saturday at 3:30 works fine, I'd be glad to host. I'll invite Jordan myself and I won't mention you at all. See you then!
Hey Jordan! I'm having a few people over at my place this Saturday, around 3:30 — come by if you're free. Would be good to see you.
Perfect — thank you, Allie. See you Saturday at 3:30.

Hey Allie, sounds great — I'm in. I've got a study session until 3:30 on Saturday, so I'll come by right after that, around 3:30. I'll have to head off by 6 for a family dinner, but that still leaves a good couple of hours. See you then!
Great, see you Saturday around 3:30 — I'll be here. No rush if you're a bit late.
